166.alt: Avatar Robotics mobile robot, full platform, side view, on its lift column and wheeled base with a tray, still from the official video
166.credit: Image: Avatar Robotics, mobile lift-column configuration, official video still
166.identity: Frame 755 (31.49 s) of the video on Avatar Robotics' homepage, decoded at its native 1920 × 1080: the whole platform in side view, with the black and white head, both arms and grippers, the tray with its packets, the rear lift column and the complete wheeled base. The shelving rack and the floor are excluded by the alpha mask; the tray and its contents are kept as part of the platform. The maker does not disclose a model name, and none is given here.

74.credit: Image: REVOBOTS, TASKBOT SCOUT mobile configuration, official video still
74.identity: Frame 292 (9.73 s) of the video on REVOBOTS' homepage, at its native 1920 × 1080 encoding: the TASKBOT SCOUT configuration, whole, with its sensor mast and dome and the complete four-wheeled base. This configuration has no arms or head, and none are added; it is the mobile platform the record lists, not humanoid hardware. The street, the car and the logos are excluded by the alpha mask; the dome is transparent, so what shows through it is the scene behind, as filmed.

70.identity: The HUBO2 product image on the HUBO2 page of Rainbow Robotics Vietnam, a regional site that hosts the maker's product material (native 1206 × 1658): the whole robot with head, both hands and both feet, the chest marked HUBO, KAIST and Rainbow.
